collision_layer_semantics: Godot requires (A.layer & B.mask) AND (B.layer & A.mask). MuJoCo collides if (contype1 & conaffinity2) OR (contype2 & conaffinity1). Mapping layer=contype, mask=conaffinity is equivalent when each geom has contype==conaffinity (true for Microduck collision/self_collision/floor).
